title: Spider-Man 2
desc: After losing his job, lover and his powers, Peter Parker feels dissatisfied with his life. Soon, amidst all this chaos, he also has to fight Doctor Octavius who poses a threat to the New York.

title: Drunken Master II
desc: Wong Fei-hung finds himself in the middle of a smuggling conspiracy, using his mastery of Drunken Boxing to take on dangerous foes and protect his homeland.

title: Terminator Salvation
desc: Judgement Day has occurred and Skynet has all but exterminated modern society. Now John Connor leads the resistance against Skynet but is unsure of victory until he encounters Marcus Wright.

title: 10,000 B.C.
desc: D'Leh belongs to the tribe of hunters and gatherers who reside in the mountain range in the Urals. When his tribe is attacked, the love of his life is taken as prisoner and the men as slaves.
